title: Synthesized Hypertrophy
author: Isaac S.
desc: This is a Push Pull Legs hypertrophy program built using the information I've collected from the Noble natties. This program is meant to build general strength in all major movement patterns.

ex.note: Don't arch your lower back and make the movement a standing bench press just to get more reps (Alex Leonidas)
pause at the bottom for about 3 seconds for a nice stretch (Alex Leonidas)
Pause at the bottom to continue to build tissue capacity
Bald Omni Man form
Keep going even after you can't get the full squeeze (Geoffrey Verity Schofield)
Make sure you warm up properly and use a full range of motion (Basement BodyBuilding)
Use figure 8 straps if you want to focus purely on your shoulders, you could also do these seated to increase stability (Alex Leonidas)
Control the weight as much as you can and don't swing the weight (Bald Omni Man)
Warm up your neck by moving your neck around with no weight for sets of 30 (Bald Omni Man)
Horse Row style (Bal Omni Man)
Feel free to use different grips on these to full develop all joint angles (Alex Leonidas/ Bald Omni Man)
Allow a little bit of momentum to even out the strength curve (GVS)
bench should be about 45 degrees, use a long tricep rope if available. (BOM/ Alex Leonidas)
Push back into the bar and lead with your elbows. your grip should be closer than your close grip bench. (Bald Omni Man/ Basement Bodybuilding)
Keep the elbows us and use a rope so all you are doing is pulling (GVS)
I'm using db and cable lateral raises in the same program to train the shoulders with a different resistance curve.
Place the weight on the back of your head and use controlled form to feel your abs (BOM)
If you can do the full stack for a bunch of reps, adjust the bench to get a better stretch or add a plate. (BOM)
Use heel elevation to bias your quads as much as possible (Bald Omni Man/ Natural Hypertrophy)
Do these with a reach and a pause at the bottom (BOM)
